title: Unchecked size multiplication in malloc (c)
description: C code computes an allocation size by multiplying two runtime values inside malloc. If the product wraps around, malloc returns a short buffer and later writes overrun it. This lexical rule flags the multiplication; the reviewer confirms the operands are bounded or switches to calloc(count, size) or a checked product.
remediation: Check the multiplication before allocating, or use calloc(count, size), which checks the product itself.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags any multiplication of identifiers inside malloc. Bounds established on earlier lines are not seen.
